name: NOAA Tides
description: Today's astronomical high/low tide predictions for places near US-jurisdiction tide-prediction stations (NOAA CO-OPS).

dataSources.purpose: Resolve the nearest NOAA tide-prediction station to a place's coordinates and fetch the next ~24 hours of high/low tide predictions.
dataSources.dataSent: Place latitude and longitude (rounded to 4 decimals) plus the resolved station ID. Sent to NOAA as `application=OpenMapX`.
dataSources.dataReceived: Station metadata (ID, name, coordinates) and high/low tide event times + heights for the requested day.
